source_acceptance_check: Disable Stage and Studio and complete an authorised decision-only draft without importing their runtimes.
source_required_evidence: Dependency graph and isolation test results

source_acceptance_check: Run a case with one engine and a case with multiple engines through the same case/evidence contract; no media dependency for unrelated work.
source_required_evidence: Composition tests and case reconstruction

source_acceptance_check: Accept supported context configuration and reject unknown or unauthorised policy changes without editing core logic.
source_required_evidence: Versioned configuration schema and negative tests

source_acceptance_check: Register a second adapter through a declared capability contract; unsupported requirements cause an explicit downgrade or block.
source_required_evidence: Adapter contract tests and capability mismatch results

source_acceptance_check: A suitably authorised maintainer can reproduce setup, run tests, diagnose a planted defect and locate the repair owner using the documented process.
source_required_evidence: Clean-checkout maintenance exercise and time record

source_acceptance_check: Exercise the explicitly supported OS/tool/file-version matrix and reject or document unsupported/lossy conversions.
source_required_evidence: Compatibility matrix, unit/coordinate checks and actual test results

source_acceptance_check: A scoped recommendation has a named implementation owner, executable work, required authority and observable completion evidence.
source_required_evidence: Work order, actual execution and acceptance evidence

source_acceptance_check: Complete the applicable quotation-to-contract-to-delivery-to-invoice workflow under the actual legal entity and current operational go-live controls.
source_required_evidence: Entity-linked operational rehearsal and reconciliation

source_acceptance_check: Measure routine administration, review and exception handling against a predeclared burden allowance; retain failed attempts.
source_required_evidence: Time logs, escalation outcomes and chosen limits

source_acceptance_check: Install on each declared supported host from a clean state, measure elapsed effort and recover from an interrupted setup.
source_required_evidence: Pinned install manifest, host matrix and install/recovery logs

source_acceptance_check: Representative users complete the intended task and correctly distinguish a scenario, evidence, readiness and authority to act.
source_required_evidence: Task completion, comprehension errors and user review records

source_acceptance_check: Meet declared service/access windows for critical functions and identify which functions remain available without network or external providers.
source_required_evidence: Service target, uptime observations and disconnection exercise

source_acceptance_check: Evaluate declared eligible tasks against a predefined quality rubric, reporting failures by severity and attempted-task denominator.
source_required_evidence: Versioned test set, execution results, incidents and uncertainty

source_acceptance_check: Repeat the documented workflow under comparable conditions and report variability, acceptance and rework rather than assuming identical outputs.
source_required_evidence: Repeated workflow trials and condition records

source_acceptance_check: Reconstruct decisions and replay eligible technical runs from pinned inputs, environment and model/provider identity within declared tolerances.
source_required_evidence: Input/output hashes, environment fingerprints, seeds/settings and replay results

source_acceptance_check: Exercise declared concurrency, queue and data-volume limits while preserving tenancy, cancellation, resource bounds and acceptable latency.
source_required_evidence: Load-test results, queue telemetry and limit settings

source_acceptance_check: Inject provider timeout, optional-engine loss and stale observation; unrelated authorised work continues or an honest manual path is available.
source_required_evidence: Fault-injection results and degraded-mode evidence

source_acceptance_check: Restore required records and assets from a backup in a clean environment; reconcile partial effects and recheck current authority before resuming.
source_required_evidence: Timed restore, integrity checks and reconciliation/revocation results

source_acceptance_check: Round-trip declared schemas and supported assets between actual tools with explicit units, coordinates, versions and conversion-loss reporting.
source_required_evidence: Interchange fixtures, schema validation and semantic comparison

source_acceptance_check: Move a core workflow to another supported host/provider through an adapter, measuring changes and listing functionality that cannot transfer.
source_required_evidence: Migration exercise, dependency inventory and capability deltas

source_acceptance_check: Reconstruct each material output and decision from case identity, source revisions, actual tool actions and outcome references; label inferred mechanisms.
source_required_evidence: Case evidence graph and trace audit

source_acceptance_check: An authorised reviewer can examine who did what and why; test unauthorised rewrite/erase attempts against the actual storage and trust-anchor design.
source_required_evidence: Access checks, retained records and tamper/rewrite test results

source_acceptance_check: Observe attempts, outcomes, failures, time and actual costs with currency and measurement basis; unknown cost remains unknown.
source_required_evidence: Telemetry sample, reconciliation and alert exercises

source_acceptance_check: Run planted defects and appropriate semantic/technical checks against predeclared claims; report which claims remain beyond the checks.
source_required_evidence: Claim-to-test mapping, defect results and residual limitations

source_acceptance_check: Bind approval to exact action revision and scope; reject revocation and expiry before effect; demonstrate effective cancellation and bounded retries.
source_required_evidence: Actual host authority tests and side-effect cancellation evidence

source_acceptance_check: Explain the recommendation using eligible evidence, assumptions, alternatives, uncertainty, dissent and conditions that would change the decision.
source_required_evidence: Decision rationale and stakeholder comprehension review

source_acceptance_check: Identify actual decision, execution, validation and repair owners and verify their entitlements and challenge routes without assuming role names confer authority.
source_required_evidence: Role/mandate records, entitlement checks and repair exercise

source_acceptance_check: Apply the same contracts to a materially different bounded case while revisiting domain competence, evidence and constraints.
source_required_evidence: Cross-context trial and documented changes/limits

source_acceptance_check: Measure total attributable delivery, review, correction, upkeep and setup costs against an explicit value case; keep capacity, quality and risk benefits distinct.
source_required_evidence: Cost/value record, pilot comparison and disclosed assumptions

source_acceptance_check: Assess recurring upkeep, founder workload, support succession and dependency-change burden over a declared operating window.
source_required_evidence: Workload records, ownership/backup plan and upgrade/regression exercise
